## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run test:local` passes (or CI is green)
- [ ] Tried it in the browser, if it changes what people see
- [ ] Database changes are a new file in `supabase/migrations`, and `npm run db:migrate -- --apply` has run, or will run before merging

## Before merging

- [ ] No secrets, passwords, real personal data or real footage in the change
- [ ] Merging deploys to the live site within about 10 minutes
